No importa, Benkei derriba al Capitán Capri, Kenta vence a Tetsuya y en un impresionante combate final, Gingka elimina a Yu.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya y Tsubasa ganan sus combates iniciales en Battle Bladers, y luego es el turno de Hyoma. Se enfrenta a un espadachín desconocido, Reiji, un miembro de la Nebulosa Oscura. El bey de Reiji, Poison Serpent, no parece muy fuerte en sus ataques, pero Hyoma se da cuenta demasiado tarde de que cada vez que su bey Aries es golpeado, se le inyecta veneno que debilita sus defensas.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Los oponentes para la próxima ronda de Battle Bladers están listos, pero la pandilla está más preocupada por la salud de Hikaru, quien fue derrotado por Ryuga en las batallas iniciales. Ella está bien, y los bladers se dan cuenta de que deben concentrarse en ganar sus próximos partidos si quieren vengar su pérdida. Mientras tanto en Dark Nebula HQ, Yu se ve obligado a luchar contra Reiji para decidir si es digno de permanecer en la Organización.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En la segunda ronda de Battle Bladers, Doji hace sus trucos habituales, cambiando las parejas de todos. Esto enfrenta a Benkei contra su ídolo Kyoya en una batalla desafiante que Kyoya gana a pesar de la increíble demostración de fuerza de Benkei. Gingka lucha contra el intenso Ryutaro, que tiene mucho en juego en esta batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla está alarmada por la forma en que la Nebulosa Oscura ha tratado a Yu, ya que está muy herido después de su batalla con Reiji. Kenta promete derrotar a Reiji por Yu y por todos los verdaderos espadachines. En su batalla con Reiji, Kenta engaña al oscuro nebulizador intercambiando su punta de rendimiento de Sagittario con la punta de la espada de Yu, Libra.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Tsubasa se prepara para su batalla más difícil, contra Ryuga y su bey Lightning L-Drago. Tsubasa tiene un plan para derrotar al Movimiento Oscuro de Ryuga y resulta efectivo ya que él y su bey Earth Eagle toman una ventaja temprana en su batalla. Sin embargo, la pelea termina con Ryuga triunfando y Tsubasa y Eagle ahora están fuera de Battle Bladers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Las semifinales de Battle Bladers demuestran ser emocionantes con Gingka enfrentando a su oponente inductor de miedo, Reiji. Mientras tanto, Yu es llevado cautivo por Doji para cumplir con su deuda con la Nebulosa Oscura. Hyoma y Kenta ven a Doji llevándose a Yu y deciden no decirle a Gingka, ya que él está en un partido importante. Van a la Nebulosa Oscura para salvar a Yu, pero se encuentran con los secuaces de Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: El intento de Kenta y Hyoma de rescatar a Yu parece haber fallado, hasta que Phoenix llega al cuartel general de Dark Nebula y entra en una terrible batalla contra Doji. En Battle Bladers, Gingka es empujado al límite cuando Reiji usa la Serpiente Venenosa para congelar a Gingka. Pero Gingka utiliza un enfoque de espejo en el que Pegasus refleja los ataques. Reiji se frustra cada vez más por la falta de miedo de Gingka hasta que Gingka finalmente toma el partido.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka y la pandilla se sorprenden al saber que el enmascarado Phoenix es en realidad el padre de Gingka, Ryo. Ryo se disculpa con un molesto Gingka por no revelar que todavía estaba vivo. Explica que tuvo que esconderse para luchar contra la Nebulosa Oscura. Ryo le dice a Gingka y a sus amigos que son los únicos que ahora pueden derrotar a Ryuga y Lightning L-Drago.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kyoya debe enfrentar a Ryuga en las semifinales de vida o muerte en Battle Bladers, el ganador para enfrentar a Gingka en el combate final. Kyoya se burla de Ryuga alegando que no puede enfrentarse solo a sus oponentes: primero debe robar el poder y la fuerza de otros espadachines. Ryuga acepta un desafío de Kyoya para hacer una batalla bey-to bey, sin restricciones. - Open

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: La pandilla todavía se está recuperando de la feroz victoria de Ryuga sobre Kyoya que dejó a su amigo débil e inconsciente. Ryuga le dice a Gingka que es culpa de Gingka que todos sus amigos sufren cuando luchan contra Ryuga, ya que solo los estaba usando para reunir más poder para llegar a Gingka. Gingka se da cuenta de que debe luchar duro contra Ryuga, por el bien de sus amigos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka se encuentra en una batalla, no con Ryuga, sino con una versión mutada de él, una criatura horrible. Gingka se niega a retroceder, y él y Pegasus luchan duro contra Dark Ryuga y su bey L-Drago. Sin embargo, el poder de L-Drago parece ser demasiado para Pegasus, hasta que Gingka se da cuenta de que ganar por la fuerza no es la respuesta.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson vuelve a casa después de ganar el campeonato mundial de BeyBlade y se cree muy importante. Pero llega tarde a la escuela y lo castigan, lo que hace que llegue también tarde a un torneo local. Cuando al fin se presenta, tiene que pelear con un chico misteriorso, míster X, que llega hasta la final para enfrentarse a Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kenny descubre que Ozuma, el Blader encapuchado que derrotó a Tyson, usó un Bit Beast invisible. Tyson exige una revancha y vuelve a perder, porque Dragoon se niega a aparecer cuando lo llama. Entretanto, unos hombres vestidos de negro han tomado datos de los encuentros entre Ozuma y Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson no supera su derrota con el misterioso Míster X. Max y Ray reciben también la visita de figuras de encapuchados y pierden también con ellos. Kenny descubre algo interesante sobre el BeyBlade de Míster X , pero antes de que pueda decírselo a Tyson, éste se encuentra en el parque con Míster X y lo reta a una revancha.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los hombres de negro secuestran a Kenny y Hilary y Tison se ve obligado a hacer lo que le piden los captores para intentar liberarlos. Termina en un barco viejo, donde tiene que enfrentarse a un robot para que los secuestradores suelten a sus amigos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson y Kenny están otra vez sanos y salvos en tierra firme y acaban deduciendo que hay gente que quiere robar los Bit Beasts de todos los miembros de los BladeBreakers. Etretanto, en la escuela de Kai hay un chico, Wyatt, que quiere que le enseñe técnicas de juego. Kai no le hace caso hasta que un tal Dunga reta a Wyatt y éste roba a Dranzer para la batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: En el centro de entrenamiento de Gideon, dos de sus secuaces descubren a un Blader de talento llamado Snakey y le ofrecen ponerle un Magtram a su Blade. El Magtram es un mecanismo que crea un campo magnético y da una ventaja injusta al que lo usa. Tyson acepta pelear con Snakey y consigue ganar, pero los secuaces de Gideon graban la pelea.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson y Kenny intentan averiguar qué había dentro del Beyblade de Snakey. Envían un mensaje a la madre de Max para pedirle ayuda y van también a ver al señor Dickenson. En su oficina conocen a un equipo nuevo llamado los Psykicks y liderado por el siniestro doctor B.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Max y Ray se unen también con sus amigos, con lo que los BladeBreakers vuelven a estar juntos. La madre de Max les ofrece el Núcleo Mg, que produce un campo magnético similar al del Magtram, pero no es fácil de controlar y tienen que entrenar mucho para lograrlo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers se dirigen a un torneo contra el equipo Psykick, pero el conductor del autobús llena el vehículo de gas para dormir y mientras están inconscientes los traslada a una isla desierta donde habita el doctor B., que tiene la misión de capturar los Bit Beast de nuestros amigos con un Sistema de Captura de Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers están atrapados en una isla misteriosa y deciden separarse. Unos van hacia el faro para intentar comunicarse con el mundo exterior y pedir ayuda y otros, Tyson, Ray y Max, llegan accidentalmente al escenario de su próximo combate, donde tienen que enfrentarse a Bat, un Blader que ve en la oscuridad. Es Ray el que lucha con él y acaba ganando.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers están atrapados en una isla misteriosa y deciden separarse. Unos van hacia el faro para intentar comunicarse con el mundo exterior y pedir ayuda y otros, Tyson, Ray y Max, llegan accidentalmente al escenario de su próximo combate, donde tienen que enfrentarse a Bat, un Blader que ve en la oscuridad. Es Ray el que lucha con él y acaba ganando.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Nuestros héroes siguen atrapados en la isla, pero el doctor B les dice que si vencen a todos los miembros del equipo Psykick podrán salir. Faltan Tyson y Kai por luchar. Kai se enfrenta a Figel y gana. Después de eso, llega al faro con Kenny y Hilary y piden ayuda. Entretanto, Tyson lucha con Daryl y también vence. El laboratorio del doctor B explota debido a una sobrecarga de ordenador y el señor Dickenson y el abuelo aparecen en helicóptero y rescatan a los chicos en el último momento.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson se recupera de una herida en el tobillo en el hospital. Gideon, entretanto, prepara otro plan siniestro y pide al doctor B que cree un Bit Beast virtual con todos los datos reunidos de los BladeBreakers. En otro lado de la ciudad, los Saint Shields planean también su estrategia para hacerse con los Bit Beasts de los BladeBreakers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Joseph, de los Saint Shields, descubre el plan de Gideon y el doctor B. Los BladeBreakers entrenan mucho para prepararse para futuros peligros. Mariam incita a Max a una batalla en un bosque cercano. Ray se encuentra a su vez con Joseph y los cuatro pelean dos a dos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Ozuma, el jefe de los Saint Shields, reta a Tyson a un combate. Tyson gana, pero Ozuma le dice que tiene que mejorar su técnica. Entretanto, el doctor B termina de crear su Cyber Bit Beats y lo prueba con Gerry, uno de los Bladers del equipo Psykick, en un torneo local. Los BladeBreakers aparecen en el torneo y ven el Beast.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Gerry no puede controlar su Cyber Bit Beast, que acaba explotando. Kenny descubre que alguien ha hecho copias de los Bit Beasts de sus amigos. Los Saint Shields están entrenando para luchar y el doctor B sigue experimentando para crear otro Cyber Bit Beast.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Wyatt vuelve y le suplica a Kai que le ayude a entrenar, pero este se niega. Wyatt jura vengarse y acepta entrar en el equipo Psykick y probar el nuevo Cyber Bit Beast. Lucha contra Dunga, y aunque vence al Vortex Ape de éste, la pelea deja muy débil a Wyatt y el doctor B lo echa del equipo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Hilary prepara una barbacoa para que el equipo descanse. El abuelo se cae al río y lo salvan cuatro Bladers que pasan por allí. Tyson se hace amigo de uno de ellos, Kane, pero este resulta ser el jefe del equipo Psykick y está confabulado con Gideon.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, y Salima llegan al laboratorio del doctor B. Jim es el primero en probar el Cyber Draciel y la experiencia lo transforma. El doctor B chantajea al señor Dickenson para que acepte un torneo entre los BladeBreakers y los Psyckicks.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Después de ver el poder de los Cyber Bit Beasts, Tyson está dispuesto a saltarse las normas de BeyBlade con tal de vencerlos. Ray protesta y exige que los BladeBreakers jueguen limpio. Se encuentra con Salima al lado del río y descubre que ella piensa como él. La chica dice que irá a verlo al día siguiente y le llevará un Cyber BeyBlade, pero no se presenta y Ray cambia de idea y decide ganar también a toda costa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson está tan decidido a ganar al equipo Psykick que pide a Kenny que altere su Dragoon contra las normas, pero luego no puede controlar su nuevo Blade y se frustra cada vez más. Entretanto, Kane y Salima prueban también los Cyber Bit Beasts y se enganchan con ellos. Ozuma, por su parte, reta a Tyson para enseñarle que no puede jugar sucio y consigue convencerlo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los Blade Breakers viajan en helicóptero al lugar donde van a combatir con los Psykick. Se trata de un edificio monolítico de cinco pisos llamado “Torre Batalla”. Los recibe Gideon en una pantalla de vídeo y les cuenta que cada combate tendrá lugar en un piso distinto. Los atacan unos robots para debilitar sus Blades antes de los combates de verdad, pero los Saint Shields acuden en su ayuda.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: La primera batalla del torneo enfrenta a Max con Jim y el Cyber Draciel. Gana Max, pero el Cyber Draciel se repara automáticamente y sigue luchando. La segunda vez Max no tiene tanta suerte y pierde. El doctor B captura a Draciel y lo guarda en un contenedor especial. Dunga está furioso con Max por habérselo dejado quitar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Ray se enfrenta a Salima en el segundo combate del torneo. Ray se entrega a fondo, no sólo por su equipo, sino por recuperar a la Salima que conoció una vez, antes de que estuviera controlada por el Cyber Bit Beast.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Después de la victoria de Ray sobre Salima, los BladeBreakers llegan al cuarto nivel, donde Kai se enfrenta a Goki. El doctor B le hace un truco mental y Kai cree que está luchando con Wyatt. Tyson le cuenta lo que está pasando en realidad y Kai se sobrepone y derrota a Goki..

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: El combate final enfrenta a Tyson contra Kane y su Cyber Dragoon. La batalla es feroz y en ella Tyson dice a Kai que el único modo de ganar es mejorando de técnica, no con la ayuda de Bit Beasts prefabricados.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson sigue luchando con Kane y los poderes del Bit Beast de éste se desarrollan a un ritmo alarmante. Dragoon está sufriendo tanto que Tyson le dice de mala gana que deje de luchar, pero el fiel Bit Beast hace acopio de fuerzas y sigue combatiendo. Tyson sigue su ejemplo y jura derrotar a Kane a toda costa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Empezamos en mitad de una batalla entre Kane y Tyson. Este último va perdiendo hasta que Kai le dice que el único modo de vencer es que destruya el Cyber Bit Beast. Tyson recurre a toda su energía y lo destruye, pero eso hace que el edificio donde están se empiece a derrumbar y nuestros héroes tienen que salir corriendo después de recuperar a Draciel, que sigue preso en el laboratorio.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los chicos llegan a Nueva York de visita y Judy, la madre de Max, los lleva al laboratorio de la BBA, donde les muestra una piedra antigua con letras misteriosas y les dice que la piedra contiene Bit Beast. Alan, un amigo de Max, les hace una demostración con uno de ellos e invita a Max a un torneo de BeyBlade al día siguiente. Pero durante la noche, unos ladrones roban la piedra y los persigue la policía y Tyson. Este último descubre que uno de los ladrones es Alan.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Max llegan al torneo y Alan le dice que, si lo derrota, le contará por qué aceptó ayudar a los malos a robar la piedra. La batalla es muy encarnizada, pero Max acaba ganado y Alan explica que participó en el robo para conseguir un Bit Beast poderoso, pero el nuevo Blade resultó ser un engaño.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Cuando los chicos vuelven a Japón acompañados por Judy, van a un laboratorio abandonado, donde el señor Dickenson tuvo en otro tiempo una piedra similar con un socio suyo, el doctor Zagart, que desapareció con la piedra. Después de una batalla con Kenny y su nuevo BeyBlade, Tyson comprende que todavía tiene que aprender a controlar a su nuevo BeyBlade, Dragoon V2.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Sabiendo que el doctor Zagart es la clave para encontrar la piedra perdida, los BladeBreakers deciden sair en su busca, aunque no saben por dónde empezar. El doctor Zagart y la doctora K diseñan un Blade nuevo con un Bit Beast de la piedra. Foxy desafía con él a Ray y está a punto de destruir su Blade, pero termina imponiéndose Ray. Los Saint Shields han visto la batalla y Ozuma jura que conseguirán los Bit Beasts de los BladeBreakes.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson empieza a cansarse de que todo el mundo quiera sus Bit Beasts y convence a Kenny de que cree una plataforma para que el equipo se entrene en ella. Paga su mal humor con Zeo, un chico admirador suyo, pero luego se arrepiente y acepta entrenar con él para ayudarle a pasar los exámenes de BeyBlade.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: El señor Dickenson descifra la escritura misteriosa de la piedra y los niños descubren que los Saint Shields pertenecen a un clan que todavía usa ese lenguaje antiguo. Ozuma les cuenta su historia y la misión que les encomendó el clan: hacerse con los cuatro Bit Beasts sagrados y sellarlos en el interior de la piedra. Dunga los reta a combate y Ray acepta, pero el nuevo Vortex Ape de Dunga es demasiado para él y pierde a Driger, que queda encerrado en el interior de la piedra.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson está entrenando cuando llega Zeo de improviso y ve a Draciel y Dragoon en el aire y decide que él también quiere tener un Bit Beast. Los demás le dicen que no es un juguete, sino que tiene que ganárselo. La doctora K extrae un Bit Beast de la piedra y se lo da a Net, quien desafía a Tyson a un combate. Dragoon gana la batalla y Net huye llorando.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kai está entrenando solo en el parque y aparece un golpe de viento que empieza a destruirlo todo. Es uno de los Blades de la doctora K, que tiene un Bit Beast que controla el viento. Kai lucha con él y consigue derrotarlo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Denis, otros de los Blades de la doctora K, tiende una emboscada a Max en las entrañas de un edificio misterioso. Mariam lo ha seguido allí para luchar con él, pero cuando lo ve combatiendo con Denis, decide ayudarle.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los Saint Shields retan a los BladeBreakers a un torneo en un parque de atracciones abandonado. Mariam y Max son los primeros en enfrentarse y vence Max. Mariam ve el gran vínculo que tiene Max con Draciel y empiza a dudar de su misión.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los Saint Shields intentan capturar a Dranzer. Para ello, Dunga entra en una batalla contra Kai, pero de pronto, Joseph lanza también su Blade y quedan luchando dos contra uno. Ray se mete a ayudar a su amigo y está tan decidido a no perder otra vez que usa un gran poder de concentración y consigue liberar su Bit Beast del interior de la piedra. Ray y Kai ganan la batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Ozuma, líder de los Saint Shields, se enfrenta a Tyson. La batalla termina en empate y Ozuma comprende que los BladeBreakers son lo bastante fuertes para cuidar de sus Bit Beasts y evitar que caigan en malas manos. Los Saint Shields se despiden de ellos y se marchan.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: La doctora K encarga a Denny, un nuevo Blader, que capture los cuatro Bit Beasts sagrados con ayuda de Clarken, su poderoso Bit Beast. Denny empieza peleando con Ray y todo va bien hasta que Denny lanza un segundo Blade. Zeo se mete a ayudar a Ray y acaban venciendo. En agradecimiento, Tyson convierte a Zeo en el quinto miembro de los BladeBreakers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers acuden al torneo del Campeonato del Mundo para animar a Zeo, que combate en los encuentros preliminares. Entretanto, la doctora K se dispone a sacar otro Bit Beast de la piedra, pero el doctor Zagart la descubre y la despide por actuar a sus espaldas y se va a su casa, donde se descubre que el doctor Zagart es el padre de Zeo. Este se da cuenta de que es su padre el que quiere robar los Bit Beasts de los BladeBreakers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Zeo empieza a entrenar con su padre. Este le entrega a Cerberus, el Bit Beast más poderoso de la piedra, pero Zeo tiene que aprender a controlarlo. Entretanto, los BladeBreakers tienen que hacer dos equipos para el Campeonato del Mundo y deciden que Tyson se empareje con Max y Kai con Ray. Poco después, Kai conoce a una extraña pareja, Rey y Reina, que lo desafían a un combate para robarle piezas de su Blade, pero éste queda tan destrozado en la batalla, que se van con las manos vacías.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kai no deja de obsesionarse con Rey y Reina y los busca para combatir en cuanto tiene un Blade nuevo. La doctora K los encuentra antes y les ofrece que se unan a ella para capturar juntos los cuatro Bit Beasts sagrados. La pareja no acepta, pero cuando luchan con Kai y pierden, cambian de idea y la llaman.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: El doctor Zagart inscribe a Zeo en los finales del Campeonato Mundial y revela que es su hijo. Rey y Reina se inscriben también en el Campeonato. Todos están decididos a ganar a toda costa.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Empieza la ronda final del Campeonato Mundial. En el primer encuentro, Gordo y Zeo derrotan a Dunga y Ozuma, pasando así a la siguiente fase.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Continúa el Campeonato y ahora Tyson y Max tienen que enfrentarse a Kane y Jim, pero Rey y Reina atacan a estos últimos por sorpresa en la calle y destrozan su Blades, por lo que Kane y Jim se ven obligados retirarse de la competición. Mariam y Joseph se enfrentan a Rey y Reina en el torneo oficial y pierden.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: En la ronda semifinal, Max y Tyson tienen que luchar con Rey y Reina. Reina pierde con Max y la doctora K recurre a trucos sucios para ayudar a Rey contra Tyson, pero Rey decide que quiere jugar limpio y acaba perdiendo con Tyson en una batalla muy encarnizada.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Kai y Ray combaten en la segunda ronda de las semifinales con Zeo y Gordo. Ray empata con Gordo, por lo que todo depende ahora del combate entre Zeo y Kai. El duelo entre lo dos es tan potente que el estadio empieza a romperse. Al final, Kai cae derrotado ante Zeo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Zeo ha conquistado a Dranzer y Tyson empieza a temerlo. Visita solo el Bey Stadium donde tendrá que enfrentarse a él en la final y Kai lo desafía a un combate para que deje de dudar de sí mismo y se concentre en la batalla con Zeo. Tyson comprende que con sus amigos a su lado no puede perder.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: En la final del Campeonato, Tyson se enfrenta a Gordo y vence. Zeo derrota a Max y el título tendrá que decidirse en un último combate entre Tyson y Zeo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Tyson tiene que luchar con Zeo, pero en esa última batalla se descubre que Zeo no es humano, sino un robot creado por el doctor Zagart para reemplazar a su hijo, que murió en un trágido accidente. Según el doctor Zagart, si Zeo consigue capturar los cuatro Bit Beasts sagrados, el poder de éstos lo convertirá en un chico de verdad. Al final gana Tyson, quien convence a Zeo de que debe ser feliz con lo que es. Y Tyson es, una vez más, el campeón del mundo de BeyBlade.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Cuando una estrella cae de los cielos, un joven blader llamado Yuki la estaba esperando. Enseguida se pone en marcha para ir en busca de Gingka, pero no es tarea fácil, pues alguien ha atraído a Gingka a una isla para combatir contra su viejo rival Kyoya.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Yuki se enfrenta en combate a un oscuro personaje llamado Johannes, pero Gingka acude a su rescate. Yuki le cuenta al grupo la historia de una estrella que cayó recientemente y que ha escogido a algunos bladers para que sean bladers legendarios. Yuki también les desvela que si el fragmento estelar cae en las manos equivocadas, se podría utilizar con malos propósitos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos están a punto de comenzar su periplo para encontrar a los ocho bladers legendarios, pero al toparse con Johannes deben combatir contra él. Gingka parece tener todas las de perder, hasta que Kyoya se une al combate y consigue derrotar a Johannes. El grupo prosigue entonces su búsqueda.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Mientras Gingka y sus acompañantes trabar amistad con los lugareños, Benkei y Kyoya encuentran a Ryuga en la cima de un volcán, y Kyoya reta a Ryuga a un combate bey. Ryuga le dice que no debería combatir porque todavía no conoce a su bey. Éste, ofendido, provoca a Ryuga.

programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

programme.title: Octaman
programme.desc: A scientific team in Mexico discover a pool of unusual baby "octopus-like" specimens. Gathering a few for analysis back at the lab, it is soon discovered that the critters belong to a gangly six-foot half man/half octopus-like creature, that's pretty angry and wants her 'babies' returnedâ€¦

programme.title: Mission for the Dragon
programme.desc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

programme.title: The Third Man
programme.desc: In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "third man" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

programme.title: The Wasp Woman
programme.desc: The head of a major cosmetics company experiments on herself with a youth formula made from royal jelly extracted from wasps, but the formula's side effects have deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist keeps his wife young by killing, stealing the bodies of, and taking the gland fluid from virgin brides.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.desc: The high-octane energy of Monster Jam ignites Hartford, Connecticut, as the superstars of the Arena Championship Series East descend upon People's Bank Arena. Rivalries reach a boiling point when the Robbins brothers, Montana and Triton, face off in a high-stakes "family affair" at the starting line, while points leader Jon Zimmer Jr. in Terminal Velocity battles to defend his top spot against the "fastest in the field," Coty Saucier in Dragon. programme.title: The Direction
programme.desc: Mark is with guest and great friend Jimmy Jennings. Jimmy helped get The Direction, Marks dream of filming outdoor TV, to reality. His team at One Call Concepts supported Marks idea of delivering The Call 811, the national call before you dig number and safe digging message, to the outdoor viewer thru outdoor TV a reality. It was Mark’s dream as a kit to host an outdoor show. - Jimmy and his team took a risk that the show would take off and it did. Now airing on multiple outdoor networks and digital distribution platforms, Jimmy’s belief and Mark’s crazy dream has taken the safe digging message to tens of millions of viewers over the last 9 years. Listen to these two reminisce on past fishing trips and watch as they go to one of Mark’s favorite fishing lakes in KY for some crazy fall largemouth bass fishing action!

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: Join LBP in Costa Rica as Ben Scherlis, owner of Dead Bob’s in St. Petersburg, shares his love for fishing aboard his charter Straight Up with a Twist.

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal
programme.desc: Ice fishing Crappies at night with Freedom Baitz Bonita Minnow!

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Southards are heads to Table Rock for the annual family vacation. Receding water poses a challenge but there’s no lack of fish or laughs at the lake!

programme.title: Baitfuel Fishing Tournament
programme.desc: Day 1 and 2 of competition for the 2025 Thousand Islands Open out of downtown Kingston, Ontario. The field will be cut in half at the days end.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he moves into the historic Orange Free State. After incredible hunts in the Eastern Cape and Northern Cape, Mark is shifting his focus to two unique and challenging species: Mouflon and Feral Goat. Join Mark as he navigates the diverse terrain of the Orange Free State, putting his skills to the test in pursuit of these wary and elusive animals. Navigating the region’s expansive plateaus, Mark must rely on his glassing skills and long-range accuracy to secure these elusive trophies. This film features an 820 Yard Shot with his Gunwerks 300PRC - by far the longest shot Mark has ever done on a live animal! This is a prime testimony for Gunwerks' Long Range University.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in Ethiopia hunting Mountain Nyala. After the first two days, Mark has taken a Menelik’s Bushbuck and a Colobus Monkey but no Mountain Nyala. Finally, on Day 3 the hunting party receives the green light from the military to hunt in the area they wanted. It's time to put the Gunwerks rifle to the test.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: Jameson Redding hooks up with Chris Funk to fish both fresh and salt water for peacock bass and snook, but beware - they might encounter spiders!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade travels to Kansas to try and bag one of the Midwest's most impressive deer!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

programme.title: Song of Arizona

programme.title: Hands Across the Border
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

programme.title: Public Cowboy, No. 1
programme.desc: Modern-day cattle rustlers use a radio, airplanes and refrigerator trucks to expedite their illegal schemes.

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: A singing-cowboy congressman (Roy Rogers) goes to Washington to save ranchers from a power dam.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
programme.desc: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: A sergeant (Lin McCarthy), a colonel (Stephen Courtleigh), a thief (Berry Kroeger) and two other Rebel deserters trek toward Cuba through the Everglades.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: An ex-convict bandit (Marlon Brando) finds the partner (Karl Malden) who betrayed him is now a town sheriff with a wife (Katy Jurado) and daughter.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

programme.title: The Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: A cowboy sleuth (Harry Carey) catches rustlers despite a rattlesnake.

programme.title: 'Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: A Mountie tracks mine robbers in the 1890s Canada.

programme.title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Rex (Rex Allen) and Slim (Slim Pickens) journey to Colorado, where Slim is expecting to claim the estate of the departed Zeke Reynolds, but the will also includes Jacqueline Reynolds and the evil Hurley siblings, and a fight ensues.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: A Texas Ranger pretends he has been discharged from service to trick outlaws into accepting him into their gang.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A Denver widow (Conchata Ferrell) with a daughter becomes a Scottish rancher's (Rip Torn) housekeeper in 1910 Wyoming.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

programme.title: Six-Gun Trail
programme.desc: Posing as an Asian, a Washington agent goes after a gem-smuggling outlaw gang.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: The Lone Rider (Bob Livingston) and his sidekick (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) crunch an Arizona grazing-land monopoly.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: After the war with Mexico, cavalry officers try to steal land from Mexican peasants to establish their own empire.

programme.title: Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The sole surviving Texas Ranger (Klinton Spilsbury) of an ambush arranged by outlaw leader Major Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) returns to fight back as a great masked western hero, The Lone Ranger.

programme.title: Dynamite Joe
programme.desc: Agent Joe Ford, nicknamed “Dynamite Joe” for his explosive methods, is assigned to escort a vital gold shipment after a string of deadly ambushes threatens U.S. finances. With danger at every turn, Joe’s skills and dynamite are the last hope to stop the outlaws behind the attacks.

programme.title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
programme.desc: Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiancé, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.

programme.title: Apache Fury
programme.desc: A judge encounters a man (Frank Latimore) he once wronged after an Apache attack. The attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

programme.title: Django the Last Killer
programme.desc: Ramon's parents are killed by men of landowner John Barrett. While trying to get revenge, Ramon is wounded but has saved the life of Rezza, an old disillusioned killer.

programme.title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
programme.desc: Johnny Dark returns from his gold mine and lands in a deadly crooked card game. Framed and hunted by bounty killer Stack, he’s wounded and taken in by the McGovern family - only to be caught in their land war against a ruthless railroad agent. As loyalties shift, Johnny’s past and fate collide.

programme.title: Return of Halleluja
programme.desc: In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

programme.title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
programme.desc: After a bank heist, a gang of outlaws convenes at a desert saloon, only to find the loot missing. Suspicion and paranoia spiral out of control, leading them to turn on each other in a deadly struggle for survival.

programme.title: The Son of Zorro
programme.desc: In imperial Mexico, Don Ricardo Villaverde leads a double life as the masked Son of Zorro, defending the oppressed from the cruel Governor Leblanche. When rebels ambush a weapons convoy and kill Don Herrera, his daughter Conchita is saved by Zorro, sparking a daring fight against tyranny.

programme.title: I Want Him Dead
programme.desc: Clayton's sister is raped and murdered. Time for lethal revenge!

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: The Lyric
programme.desc: An aspiring singer discovers the lyrics in a song written for her could lead her to the killer of the writer who wrote it.

programme.title: The Betrayal 4: Wicked Nights
programme.desc: Wicked days, wicked nights, wicked feelings. Tk & Glizzy won’t rest until one of them controls the city. Following their daily struggles on the streets of Atlanta, we will soon see why the streets are divided & why family means nothing! Blood chaos & mayhem, the kind of betrayal that reminds us that no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Drug kingpin Jay looks to expand his drug empire with the help of his business partners, and his girlfriend Passion. However, Polo and Marco have their own agenda’s, which could lead to chaos, as a potential drug war descends upon Atlanta.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: Nowhere to be Found
programme.desc: Two sisters go on a senior trip to Mexico, led by Ava’s boyfriend Trent. Meanwhile, journalist Jessica Vandross is going to the same Mexican town in search of her sister’s killer after escaping a sex trafficking ring. These stories collide, in a thrilling fight for their lives.

programme.title: Office Secrets
programme.desc: Alvin work at a grueling corporate job, where he is constantly under foot of his drug addicted, gambling boss. He crosses paths with Victoria, who recently freed herself from a betrayal from her husband, but has an agenda all her own. Alvin plans to pull the curtain back on his boss, but has to watch his toes going against Victoria.

programme.title: Her Other Man
programme.desc: Looking to spice up their marriage, Kennedy invites another man, Billy, into the bedroom with her husband Ronny. When Billy is found dead, Ronny is being questioned about his murder.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.
